verdict.reasons: The candidate accurately features the white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll. The primary branding ('AFP', 'Drip Irrigation Tape', and Persian subtext) is authentic and clearly readable. The installation (seedlings and black irrigation laterals) supports the agronomy focus. The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is present and legible. Minor advisory notes include slight texture repetition in the background foliage, which does not impact the core product identity or overall integrity.

focused_physical_review.reason: A distinct black tape line emerges from the white-and-blue package's side and travels across the soil to the base of the separate loose coil. This line is physically adjacent to and connected to the package base. While there is visible soil around the carton, the direct emergence of the line from the package footprint prevents a 'broad uninterrupted soil gap' around the complete perimeter. There is one distinct additional loose coil of uninstalled black tape on the ground, separate from the roll contained in the carton. No white ribbons or tape tails are visible protruding from the carton itself.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: line_touches_or_crosses_package
Independent physical condition not met: extra_loose_product_coil

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
